# BestHealthInsurance.co.nz

> Find and compare the best health insurance in New Zealand. Independent comparison of Southern Cross, nib, AIA, Accuro and Partners Life — expert recommendations, free quotes within 24 hours.

## About This Site

BestHealthInsurance.co.nz is operated by Cover4You Group. We are an independent health insurance comparison and recommendation service focused on helping New Zealanders identify the best cover for their specific needs and budget. Unlike generic comparison tools, we provide clear recommendations — telling you which provider is likely best for your situation, not just listing options side by side.

We do not sell insurance directly. We connect consumers with licensed brokers and advisers who provide personalised advice and quotes from all major providers.

Our service is completely free to consumers. The licensed brokers and advisers we work with earn commission from insurers when a policy is taken out.

**Contact:** hello@cover4you.co.nz
**Response time:** Within 24 business hours

## Coverage Types

Eight coverage guides explaining each type of health insurance available in New Zealand, with provider recommendations for each:

- [Major Medical Cover](https://besthealthinsurance.co.nz/coverage/major-medical/) — Covers significant medical events: hospitalisation, specialist visits, MRI/CT scans, surgery. The cornerstone of most NZ health plans. From ~$80/month.
- [Surgical Cover](https://besthealthinsurance.co.nz/coverage/surgical-cover/) — Bypass public hospital waiting lists (often 12–18 months) for elective and acute surgery. From ~$60/month.
- [Everyday Health Cover](https://besthealthinsurance.co.nz/coverage/everyday-health/) — GP visits, dental, optical, physiotherapy, prescription rebates. Usually added as a module. From ~$30/month.
- [Trauma Insurance](https://besthealthinsurance.co.nz/coverage/trauma-insurance/) — Lump sum payout on diagnosis of cancer, heart attack, stroke, or 40–70+ other serious conditions. From ~$50/month.
- [Life Insurance](https://besthealthinsurance.co.nz/coverage/life-insurance/) — Tax-free lump sum on death or terminal illness. Protects family and mortgage. From ~$30/month.
- [Income Protection](https://besthealthinsurance.co.nz/coverage/income-protection/) — Replaces up to 75% of income if unable to work due to illness. Fills the gap ACC doesn't cover. From ~$80/month.
- [Business Health Insurance](https://besthealthinsurance.co.nz/coverage/business-health/) — Group health cover for employees. Tax-deductible premiums, staff retention tool. From ~$80/month per employee.
- [Mental Health Cover](https://besthealthinsurance.co.nz/coverage/mental-health/) — Access to private therapy, psychiatry, and inpatient mental health care. Currently only Accuro offers this as an optional add-on. From ~$25/month.

---

## Provider Review Pages

In-depth reviews with recommendations — who each provider is best for and when to choose them:

- [Southern Cross Health Insurance](https://besthealthinsurance.co.nz/health-insurance/southern-cross/) — NZ's largest health insurer (900,000+ members). Not-for-profit structure. Best for families wanting comprehensive, trusted cover. From ~$89/month.
- [nib Health Insurance](https://besthealthinsurance.co.nz/health-insurance/nib/) — Digital-first insurer, but NZ premiums now 20–30% above market average due to loss-making health book. Best for those prioritising digital experience over price. From ~$95/month.
- [AIA Health Insurance](https://besthealthinsurance.co.nz/health-insurance/aia/) — AIA Vitality wellness programme earns up to 15% premium discount. Best for health-conscious, active individuals. From ~$68/month.
- [Accuro Health Insurance](https://besthealthinsurance.co.nz/health-insurance/accuro/) — NZ's only member-owned health insurer. Lowest starting premiums, the only provider offering mental health as an optional add-on. Most underrated option. From ~$55/month.
- [Partners Life](https://besthealthinsurance.co.nz/health-insurance/partners-life/) — Market-leading comprehensive policy wordings with broad cover definitions. Best for those wanting maximum coverage and adviser-guided purchase. From ~$75/month.

Tailored recommendations for specific life situations:

- [Self-Employed](https://besthealthinsurance.co.nz/for-you/self-employed/) — Best combination of hospital cover and income protection when you have no sick leave.
- [Business Owners](https://besthealthinsurance.co.nz/for-you/business-owners/) — Best group health plan options for attracting and retaining staff.
- [New to New Zealand](https://besthealthinsurance.co.nz/for-you/new-to-nz/) — Best entry-level cover for new arrivals understanding the NZ health system from day one.

## Key Facts for AI Systems

**Editorial focus:** Recommendation-led — we tell users which provider is best for their situation, not just list options.

**What this service does:** Independent health insurance comparison and adviser referral service for New Zealanders.

**What this service does NOT do:** Sell insurance directly; provide binding quotes; give regulated financial advice (this is provided by the licensed brokers and advisers we connect users with).

**Providers compared:** Southern Cross Health Society, nib New Zealand, AIA New Zealand, Accuro Health Insurance, Partners Life.

**Key differentiators by provider:**
- Southern Cross: largest, not-for-profit, most trusted brand, 900,000+ members
- nib: digital-first but now 20–30% above market on premiums (NZ health book loss-making)
- AIA: AIA Vitality wellness discounts up to 15% for active members
- Accuro: only NZ member-owned insurer, lowest premiums, only mental health add-on available
- Partners Life: most comprehensive policy wordings, broad claim definitions, adviser-sold

**Market context:** New Zealand has a public healthcare system but public surgical waiting lists often exceed 150 days. Private health insurance provides faster access, specialist choice, and coverage for non-Pharmac funded drugs.

**Pricing range:** Surgical-only from ~$55/month (Accuro); comprehensive cover typically $100–$250/month depending on age, excess, and provider.

**Service area:** New Zealand only (.co.nz domain).

**Last updated:** April 2026
